title: CareProviderSearchConfig - Metadata API
description: Represents the information about the fields that appear in care provider search results. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

isActive.description: Indicates whether this configuration is active (true) or not (false).

isProtected.description: An auto-generated value that doesn’t currently impact the behavior of the metadata type.

mappedObject.description: Indicates mapped objects. Possible values are; HealthCarePractitionerFacility HealthCareProvider

sourceField.description: API name of the field that is copied to the target object.

targetField.description: API name of the field to copy the data to.
